newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Silver down in Europe but attracts buying interest.
newsitem.headline: Silver down in Europe but attracts buying interest.

text.p: Silver opened Wednesday under pressure in Europe with U.S. funds continuing to liquidate positions.
But dealers also noticed active buying interest from the Middle East and India, putting a brake on silver's slide.
Silver opened below the psychologically important level of 500 cents an ounce at 496/498 cents compared with its previous London close of 503/505.
Next support was seeen at 595 and 590.
Gold opened steady to slightly firmer in sluggish trading.
Gold was quoted at $350.50/350.90 compared with London's $350.20/350.70, but down from New York's $351.70/352.20.
In Hong Kong gold was steady.
Dealer saw gold moving between $350 and $351.50 in quiet trade.
Other precious metals were firmer, but very quiet.
Platinum opened at $370.90/371.90 from $369.00/370.00, while palladium was quoted at $147.25/148.25 from $146.75/147.75.
